leadText: The Best is the opening theme for the 2012 Korean redubbing of Mewtwo Strikes Back and Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution. It is performed by Lee Suji.
plainText:
The Best is the opening theme for the 2012 Korean redubbing of Mewtwo Strikes Back and Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution. It is performed by Lee Suji.

==Lyrics==
 
! Korean
! English

 
 
 
 
 
 (forever with you)
 
 
I wanna be the best It's my destiny

 
 
 
 
 
 (forever with you)
 
 

I wanna be the best It's my destiny
Never say never....
 

Wherever you are hiding (though no one knows)
I can meet you anytime (I can find out)
If I close my eyes, the joyful world
Suddenly approaches me, let's head out together
Don't worry, if we're together
The dream will be accomplished, really (forever with you) 
Even when I'm tired, I won't give up
Because you're here (Pikachu)
I wanna be the best, it's my destiny

Wherever you are hiding (though no one knows)
I can meet you anytime (I can find out)
If I close my eyes, the joyful world
Suddenly approaches me, let's head out together
Don't worry, if we're together
The dream will be accomplished, really (forever with you) 
Even when I'm tired, I won't give up
Because you're here (Pikachu)

I wanna be the best, it's my destiny
Never say never.... 

==Video==
